annotations.text:
Why this one solves the problem:

The bar's other three glyphs are monochrome vectors that carry selection by going #7D7979 -> #2D2B2B. A colour emoji cannot.

Option D sidesteps it rather than working around it — the emoji only ever appears on the tab that is already selected, so it never has to say "off".

The four that were not taken, kept for the record.

A and C left the emoji visible at rest, where it outshouts the tab you are actually on. B rings it in a disc but drops it to 15 points. E keeps both marks in one 29-point box, which is busy at the size a tab bar gets looked at.
